data.one_liner: Text widget with formatted text using tags for easier multilingual styling.
data.what_it_does: Allows formatting parts of text using XML-like tags inside strings. Makes it easy to style specific words, insert icons, handle click actions on parts of text, or embed custom widgets within localized text strings.
use_when: You need to style portions of translated or dynamic text using tags
You want to insert interactive links, icons, or widgets directly inside text paragraphs
avoid_when: You need complex rich text formatting that does not fit into a string-plus-tags model
strengths: Simplifies handling formatted text in multilingual applications
Supports inline widgets, icons, tap handlers, and custom attribute parsers
weaknesses: Relies on parsing XML tags within plain text strings which can be error-prone if escaping is missed

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick auto_size_text if your primary requirement is automatically resizing text to fit its container rather than inline tag formatting.
